```text
374	// EarlyResponseForGoGetMeta responses appropriate go-get meta with status 200
375	// if user does not have actual access to the requested repository,
376	// or the owner or repository does not exist at all.
377	// This is particular a workaround for "go get" command which does not respect
378	// .netrc file.
379	func EarlyResponseForGoGetMeta(ctx *Context) {
380		username := ctx.PathParam("username")
381		reponame := strings.TrimSuffix(ctx.PathParam("reponame"), ".git")
382		if username == "" || reponame == "" {
383			ctx.PlainText(http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid repository path")
384			return
385		}
386
387		var cloneURL string
388		if setting.Repository.GoGetCloneURLProtocol == "ssh" {
389			cloneURL = repo_model.ComposeSSHCloneURL(ctx.Doer, username, reponame)
390		} else {
391			cloneURL = repo_model.ComposeHTTPSCloneURL(ctx, username, reponame)
392		}
393		goImportContent := fmt.Sprintf("%s git %s", ComposeGoGetImport(ctx, username, reponame), cloneURL)
394		htmlMeta := fmt.Sprintf(`<meta name="go-import" content="%s">`, html.EscapeString(goImportContent))
395		ctx.PlainText(http.StatusOK, htmlMeta)
396	}

398	// RedirectToRepo redirect to a differently-named repository
399	func RedirectToRepo(ctx *Base, redirectRepoID int64) {
400		ownerName := ctx.PathParam("username")
401		previousRepoName := ctx.PathParam("reponame")
402
403		repo, err := repo_model.GetRepositoryByID(ctx, redirectRepoID)
404		if err != nil {
405			log.Error("GetRepositoryByID: %v", err)
406			ctx.HTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "GetRepositoryByID")
407			return
408		}
409
410		redirectPath := strings.Replace(
411			ctx.Req.URL.EscapedPath(),
412			url.PathEscape(ownerName)+"/"+url.PathEscape(previousRepoName),
413			url.PathEscape(repo.OwnerName)+"/"+url.PathEscape(repo.Name),
414			1,
415		)
416		if ctx.Req.URL.RawQuery != "" {
417			redirectPath += "?" + ctx.Req.URL.RawQuery
418		}
419		// Git client needs a 301 redirect by default to follow the new location
420		// It's not documentated in git documentation, but it's the behavior of git client
421		ctx.Redirect(path.Join(setting.AppSubURL, redirectPath), http.StatusMovedPermanently)
422	}
```

```text
56	// loadSecret load the secret from ini by uriKey or verbatimKey, only one of them could be set
57	// If the secret is loaded from uriKey (file), the file should be non-empty, to guarantee the behavior stable and clear.
58	func loadSecret(sec ConfigSection, uriKey, verbatimKey string) string {
59		// don't allow setting both URI and verbatim string
60		uri := sec.Key(uriKey).String()
61		verbatim := sec.Key(verbatimKey).String()
62		if uri != "" && verbatim != "" {
63			log.Fatal("Cannot specify both %s and %s", uriKey, verbatimKey)
64		}
65
66		// if we have no URI, use verbatim
67		if uri == "" {
68			return verbatim
69		}
70
71		tempURI, err := url.Parse(uri)
72		if err != nil {
73			log.Fatal("Failed to parse %s (%s): %v", uriKey, uri, err)
74		}
75		switch tempURI.Scheme {
76		case "file":
77			buf, err := os.ReadFile(tempURI.RequestURI())
78			if err != nil {
79				log.Fatal("Failed to read %s (%s): %v", uriKey, tempURI.RequestURI(), err)
80			}
81			val := strings.TrimSpace(string(buf))
82			if val == "" {
83				// The file shouldn't be empty, otherwise we can not know whether the user has ever set the KEY or KEY_URI
84				// For example: if INTERNAL_TOKEN_URI=file:///empty-file,
85				// Then if the token is re-generated during installation and saved to INTERNAL_TOKEN
86				// Then INTERNAL_TOKEN and INTERNAL_TOKEN_URI both exist, that's a fatal error (they shouldn't)
87				log.Fatal("Failed to read %s (%s): the file is empty", uriKey, tempURI.RequestURI())
88			}
89			return val
90
91		// only file URIs are allowed
92		default:
93			log.Fatal("Unsupported URI-Scheme %q (%q = %q)", tempURI.Scheme, uriKey, uri)
94			return ""
95		}
96	}
```

```text
100	func twofaGenerateSecretAndQr(ctx *context.Context) bool {
101		var otpKey *otp.Key
102		var err error
103		uri := ctx.Session.Get("twofaUri")
104		if uri != nil {
105			otpKey, err = otp.NewKeyFromURL(uri.(string))
106			if err != nil {
107				ctx.ServerError("SettingsTwoFactor: Failed NewKeyFromURL: ", err)
108				return false
109			}
110		}
111		// Filter unsafe character ':' in issuer
112		issuer := strings.ReplaceAll(setting.AppName+" ("+setting.Domain+")", ":", "")
113		if otpKey == nil {
114			otpKey, err = totp.Generate(totp.GenerateOpts{
115				SecretSize:  40,
116				Issuer:      issuer,
117				AccountName: ctx.Doer.Name,
118			})
119			if err != nil {
120				ctx.ServerError("SettingsTwoFactor: totpGenerate Failed", err)
121				return false
122			}
123		}
124
125		ctx.Data["TwofaSecret"] = otpKey.Secret()
126		img, err := otpKey.Image(320, 240)
127		if err != nil {
128			ctx.ServerError("SettingsTwoFactor: otpKey image generation failed", err)
129			return false
130		}
131
132		var imgBytes bytes.Buffer
133		if err = png.Encode(&imgBytes, img); err != nil {
134			ctx.ServerError("SettingsTwoFactor: otpKey png encoding failed", err)
135			return false
136		}
137
138		ctx.Data["QrUri"] = template.URL("data:image/png;base64," + base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(imgBytes.Bytes()))
139
140		if err := ctx.Session.Set("twofaSecret", otpKey.Secret()); err != nil {
141			ctx.ServerError("SettingsTwoFactor: Failed to set session for twofaSecret", err)
142			return false
143		}
144
145		if err := ctx.Session.Set("twofaUri", otpKey.String()); err != nil {
146			ctx.ServerError("SettingsTwoFactor: Failed to set session for twofaUri", err)
147			return false
148		}
149
150		// Here we're just going to try to release the session early
151		if err := ctx.Session.Release(); err != nil {
152			// we'll tolerate errors here as they *should* get saved elsewhere
153			log.Error("Unable to save changes to the session: %v", err)
154		}
155		return true
156	}

189	// EnrollTwoFactorPost handles enrolling the user into 2FA.
190	func EnrollTwoFactorPost(ctx *context.Context) {
191		if user_model.IsFeatureDisabledWithLoginType(ctx.Doer, setting.UserFeatureManageMFA) {
192			ctx.HTTPError(http.StatusNotFound)
193			return
194		}
195
196		form := web.GetForm(ctx).(*forms.TwoFactorAuthForm)
197		ctx.Data["Title"] = ctx.Tr("settings_title")
198		ctx.Data["PageIsSettingsSecurity"] = true
199		ctx.Data["ShowTwoFactorRequiredMessage"] = false
200
201		t, err := auth.GetTwoFactorByUID(ctx, ctx.Doer.ID)
202		if t != nil {
203			// already enrolled
204			ctx.Flash.Error(ctx.Tr("settings.twofa_is_enrolled"))
205			ctx.Redirect(setting.AppSubURL + "/user/settings/security")
206			return
207		}
208		if err != nil && !auth.IsErrTwoFactorNotEnrolled(err) {
209			ctx.ServerError("SettingsTwoFactor: Failed to check if already enrolled with GetTwoFactorByUID", err)
210			return
211		}
212
213		if ctx.HasError() {
214			if !twofaGenerateSecretAndQr(ctx) {
215				return
216			}
217			ctx.HTML(http.StatusOK, tplSettingsTwofaEnroll)
218			return
219		}
220
221		secretRaw := ctx.Session.Get("twofaSecret")
222		if secretRaw == nil {
223			ctx.Flash.Error(ctx.Tr("settings.twofa_failed_get_secret"))
224			ctx.Redirect(setting.AppSubURL + "/user/settings/security/two_factor/enroll")
225			return
226		}
227
228		secret := secretRaw.(string)
229		if !totp.Validate(form.Passcode, secret) {
230			if !twofaGenerateSecretAndQr(ctx) {
231				return
232			}
233			ctx.Flash.Error(ctx.Tr("settings.passcode_invalid"))
234			ctx.Redirect(setting.AppSubURL + "/user/settings/security/two_factor/enroll")
235			return
236		}
237
238		t = &auth.TwoFactor{
239			UID: ctx.Doer.ID,
240		}
241		err = t.SetSecret(secret)
242		if err != nil {
243			ctx.ServerError("SettingsTwoFactor: Failed to set secret", err)
244			return
245		}
246		token, err := t.GenerateScratchToken()
247		if err != nil {
248			ctx.ServerError("SettingsTwoFactor: Failed to generate scratch token", err)
249			return
250		}
251
252		newTwoFactorErr := auth.NewTwoFactor(ctx, t)
253		if newTwoFactorErr == nil {
254			_ = ctx.Session.Set(session.KeyUserHasTwoFactorAuth, true)
255		}
256		// Now we have to delete the secrets - because if we fail to insert then it's highly likely that they have already been used
257		// If we can detect the unique constraint failure below we can move this to after the NewTwoFactor
258		if err := ctx.Session.Delete("twofaSecret"); err != nil {
259			// tolerate this failure - it's more important to continue
260			log.Error("Unable to delete twofaSecret from the session: Error: %v", err)
261		}
262		if err := ctx.Session.Delete("twofaUri"); err != nil {
263			// tolerate this failure - it's more important to continue
264			log.Error("Unable to delete twofaUri from the session: Error: %v", err)
265		}
266		if err := ctx.Session.Release(); err != nil {
267			// tolerate this failure - it's more important to continue
268			log.Error("Unable to save changes to the session: %v", err)
269		}
270
271		if newTwoFactorErr != nil {
272			// FIXME: We need to handle a unique constraint fail here it's entirely possible that another request has beaten us.
273			// If there is a unique constraint fail we should just tolerate the error
274			ctx.ServerError("SettingsTwoFactor: Failed to save two factor", newTwoFactorErr)
275			return
276		}
277
278		ctx.Flash.Success(ctx.Tr("settings.twofa_enrolled", token))
```

```text
27	// WebAuthnRegister initializes the webauthn registration procedure
28	func WebAuthnRegister(ctx *context.Context) {
29		if user_model.IsFeatureDisabledWithLoginType(ctx.Doer, setting.UserFeatureManageMFA) {
30			ctx.HTTPError(http.StatusNotFound)
31			return
32		}
33
34		form := web.GetForm(ctx).(*forms.WebauthnRegistrationForm)
35		if form.Name == "" {
36			// Set name to the hexadecimal of the current time
37			form.Name = strconv.FormatInt(time.Now().UnixNano(), 16)
38		}
39
40		cred, err := auth.GetWebAuthnCredentialByName(ctx, ctx.Doer.ID, form.Name)
41		if err != nil && !auth.IsErrWebAuthnCredentialNotExist(err) {
42			ctx.ServerError("GetWebAuthnCredentialsByUID", err)
43			return
44		}
45		if cred != nil {
46			ctx.HTTPError(http.StatusConflict, "Name already taken")
47			return
48		}
49
50		_ = ctx.Session.Delete("webauthnRegistration")
51		if err := ctx.Session.Set("webauthnName", form.Name); err != nil {
52			ctx.ServerError("Unable to set session key for webauthnName", err)
53			return
54		}
55
56		webAuthnUser := wa.NewWebAuthnUser(ctx, ctx.Doer)
57		credentialOptions, sessionData, err := wa.WebAuthn.BeginRegistration(webAuthnUser, webauthn.WithAuthenticatorSelection(protocol.AuthenticatorSelection{
58			ResidentKey: protocol.ResidentKeyRequirementRequired,
59		}))
60		if err != nil {
61			ctx.ServerError("Unable to BeginRegistration", err)
62			return
63		}
64
65		// Save the session data as marshaled JSON
66		if err = ctx.Session.Set("webauthnRegistration", sessionData); err != nil {
67			ctx.ServerError("Unable to set session", err)
68			return
69		}
70
71		ctx.JSON(http.StatusOK, credentialOptions)
72	}
73
74	// WebauthnRegisterPost receives the response of the security key
75	func WebauthnRegisterPost(ctx *context.Context) {
76		if user_model.IsFeatureDisabledWithLoginType(ctx.Doer, setting.UserFeatureManageMFA) {
77			ctx.HTTPError(http.StatusNotFound)
78			return
79		}
80
81		name, ok := ctx.Session.Get("webauthnName").(string)
82		if !ok || name == "" {
83			ctx.ServerError("Get webauthnName", errors.New("no webauthnName"))
84			return
85		}
86
87		// Load the session data
88		sessionData, ok := ctx.Session.Get("webauthnRegistration").(*webauthn.SessionData)
89		if !ok || sessionData == nil {
90			ctx.ServerError("Get registration", errors.New("no registration"))
91			return
92		}
93		defer func() {
94			_ = ctx.Session.Delete("webauthnRegistration")
95		}()
96
97		// Verify that the challenge succeeded
98		webAuthnUser := wa.NewWebAuthnUser(ctx, ctx.Doer)
99		cred, err := wa.WebAuthn.FinishRegistration(webAuthnUser, *sessionData, ctx.Req)
100		if err != nil {
101			if pErr, ok := err.(*protocol.Error); ok {
102				log.Error("Unable to finish registration due to error: %v\nDevInfo: %s", pErr, pErr.DevInfo)
103			}
104			ctx.ServerError("CreateCredential", err)
105			return
106		}
107
108		dbCred, err := auth.GetWebAuthnCredentialByName(ctx, ctx.Doer.ID, name)
109		if err != nil && !auth.IsErrWebAuthnCredentialNotExist(err) {
110			ctx.ServerError("GetWebAuthnCredentialsByUID", err)
111			return
112		}
113		if dbCred != nil {
114			ctx.HTTPError(http.StatusConflict, "Name already taken")
115			return
116		}
117
118		// Create the credential
119		_, err = auth.CreateCredential(ctx, ctx.Doer.ID, name, cred)
120		if err != nil {
121			ctx.ServerError("CreateCredential", err)
122			return
123		}
124		_ = ctx.Session.Delete("webauthnName")
125		_ = ctx.Session.Set(session.KeyUserHasTwoFactorAuth, true)
126		ctx.JSON(http.StatusCreated, cred)
127	}
128
129	// WebauthnRename renames a security key by id
130	func WebauthnRename(ctx *context.Context) {
131		if user_model.IsFeatureDisabledWithLoginType(ctx.Doer, setting.UserFeatureManageMFA) {
132			ctx.HTTPError(http.StatusNotFound)
133			return
134		}
135
136		if ctx.HasError() { // form binding validation error
137			ctx.JSONError(ctx.GetErrMsg())
138			return
139		}
140
141		cred, err := auth.GetWebAuthnCredentialByID(ctx, ctx.FormInt64("id"))
142		if err != nil && !auth.IsErrWebAuthnCredentialNotExist(err) {
143			ctx.ServerError("GetWebAuthnCredentialByID", err)
144			return
145		}
146		if cred == nil || cred.UserID != ctx.Doer.ID { // hide other users' keys as not found
147			ctx.JSONErrorNotFound()
148			return
149		}
150
151		form := web.GetForm(ctx).(*forms.WebauthnRenameForm)
152		form.Name = strings.TrimSpace(form.Name)
153		if form.Name == "" { // "Required" binding only rejects an exactly empty value, not whitespace
154			ctx.JSONError(ctx.Locale.TrString("settings.webauthn_nickname") + ctx.Locale.TrString("form.require_error"))
155			return
156		}
157		sameName, err := auth.GetWebAuthnCredentialByName(ctx, ctx.Doer.ID, form.Name)
158		if err != nil && !auth.IsErrWebAuthnCredentialNotExist(err) {
159			ctx.ServerError("GetWebAuthnCredentialByName", err)
160			return
161		}
162		if sameName != nil && sameName.ID != cred.ID { // renaming a key to its own name with different casing is allowed
163			ctx.JSONError(ctx.Tr("settings.webauthn_nickname_taken"))
164			return
165		}
166
167		if err := auth.UpdateCredentialName(ctx, cred.ID, ctx.Doer.ID, form.Name); err != nil {
168			ctx.ServerError("UpdateCredentialName", err)
169			return
170		}
171		ctx.Flash.Success(ctx.Tr("settings.webauthn_rename_key_success"))
172		ctx.JSONRedirect(setting.AppSubURL + "/user/settings/security")
173	}
174
175	// WebauthnDelete deletes an security key by id
176	func WebauthnDelete(ctx *context.Context) {
177		if user_model.IsFeatureDisabledWithLoginType(ctx.Doer, setting.UserFeatureManageMFA) {
178			ctx.HTTPError(http.StatusNotFound)
179			return
180		}
181
182		if _, err := auth.DeleteCredential(ctx, ctx.FormInt64("id"), ctx.Doer.ID); err != nil {
183			ctx.ServerError("GetWebAuthnCredentialByID", err)
184			return
185		}
186		ctx.JSONRedirect(setting.AppSubURL + "/user/settings/security")
187	}
```

```text
		opts.SetLastLogin = true

			session.KeyUserHasTwoFactorAuth: userHasTwoFactorAuth,

			return
		}
```

```text
173	func (p *Permission) LogString() string {
174		var format strings.Builder
175		format.WriteString("<Permission AccessMode=%s, %d Units, %d UnitsMode(s): [")
176		args := []any{p.AccessMode.ToString(), len(p.units), len(p.unitsMode)}

189		}

202	func applyPublicAccessPermission(unitType unit.Type, accessMode perm_model.AccessMode, modeMap *map[unit.Type]perm_model.AccessMode) {
203		if setting.Repository.ForcePrivate {
204			return
205		}
206		if accessMode >= perm_model.AccessModeRead && accessMode > (*modeMap)[unitType] {
207			if *modeMap == nil {
208				*modeMap = make(map[unit.Type]perm_model.AccessMode)
209			}
210			(*modeMap)[unitType] = accessMode
211		}
212	}

214	func finalProcessRepoUnitPermission(user *user_model.User, perm *Permission) {
215		// apply public (anonymous) access permissions
216		for _, u := range perm.units {
217			applyPublicAccessPermission(u.Type, u.AnonymousAccessMode, &perm.anonymousAccessMode)
218		}
219
220		if user == nil || user.ID <= 0 {
221			// for anonymous access, it could be:
222			// AccessMode is None or Read, units has repo units, unitModes is nil
223			return
224		}
225
226		// apply public (everyone) access permissions
227		for _, u := range perm.units {
228			applyPublicAccessPermission(u.Type, u.EveryoneAccessMode, &perm.everyoneAccessMode)
229		}
230
231		if perm.unitsMode == nil {
232			// if unitsMode is not set, then it means that the default p.AccessMode applies to all units
233			return
234		}
235
236		// remove no permission units
237		origPermUnits := perm.units
238		perm.units = make([]*repo_model.RepoUnit, 0, len(perm.units))
239		for _, u := range origPermUnits {
240			shouldKeep := false
241			for t := range perm.unitsMode {
242				if shouldKeep = u.Type == t; shouldKeep {
243					break
244				}
245			}
246			for t := range perm.anonymousAccessMode {
247				if shouldKeep = shouldKeep || u.Type == t; shouldKeep {
248					break
249				}
250			}
251			for t := range perm.everyoneAccessMode {
252				if shouldKeep = shouldKeep || u.Type == t; shouldKeep {
253					break
254				}
255			}
256			if shouldKeep {
257				perm.units = append(perm.units, u)
258			}
259		}
260	}

262	func checkSameOwnerCrossRepoAccess(ctx context.Context, taskRepo, targetRepo *repo_model.Repository, isForkPR bool) bool {
263		if isForkPR {
264			// Fork PRs are never allowed cross-repo access to other private repositories of the owner.
265			return false
266		}
267		if taskRepo.OwnerID != targetRepo.OwnerID {
268			return false
269		}
270		ownerCfg, err := actions_model.GetOwnerActionsConfig(ctx, targetRepo.OwnerID)
271		if err != nil {
272			log.Error("GetOwnerActionsConfig: %v", err)
273			return false
274		}
275
276		return slices.Contains(ownerCfg.AllowedCrossRepoIDs, targetRepo.ID)
277	}

279	// GetActionsUserRepoPermission returns the actions user permissions to the repository
280	func GetActionsUserRepoPermission(ctx context.Context, repo *repo_model.Repository, actionsUser *user_model.User, taskID int64) (perm Permission, err error) {
281		if actionsUser.ID != user_model.ActionsUserID {
282			return perm, errors.New("api GetActionsUserRepoPermission can only be called by the actions user")
283		}
284		task, err := actions_model.GetTaskByID(ctx, taskID)
285		if err != nil {
286			return perm, err
287		}
288
289		if err := task.LoadJob(ctx); err != nil {
290			return perm, err
291		}
292
293		var taskRepo *repo_model.Repository
294		if task.RepoID != repo.ID {
295			if err := task.Job.LoadRepo(ctx); err != nil {
296				return perm, err
297			}
298			taskRepo = task.Job.Repo
299		} else {
300			taskRepo = repo
301		}
302
303		// Compute effective permissions for this task against the target repo
304		effectivePerms, err := actions_model.ComputeTaskTokenPermissions(ctx, task, repo)
305		if err != nil {
306			return perm, err
307		}
308		if task.RepoID != repo.ID {
309			// Cross-repo access must also respect the target repo's permission ceiling.
310			targetRepoActionsCfg := repo.MustGetUnit(ctx, unit.TypeActions).ActionsConfig()
311			if targetRepoActionsCfg.OverrideOwnerConfig {
312				effectivePerms = targetRepoActionsCfg.ClampPermissions(effectivePerms)
313			} else {
314				targetRepoOwnerActionsCfg, err := actions_model.GetOwnerActionsConfig(ctx, repo.OwnerID)
315				if err != nil {
316					return perm, err
317				}
318				effectivePerms = targetRepoOwnerActionsCfg.ClampPermissions(effectivePerms)
319			}
320		}
321
322		if err := repo.LoadUnits(ctx); err != nil {
323			return perm, err
324		}
325
326		var maxPerm Permission
327
328		// Set up per-unit access modes based on configured permissions
329		maxPerm.units = repo.Units
330		maxPerm.unitsMode = maps.Clone(effectivePerms.UnitAccessModes)
331
332		// Check permission like simple user but limit to read-only (PR #36095)
333		// Enhanced to also grant read-only access if isSameRepo is true and target repository is public
334		botPerm, err := GetIndividualUserRepoPermission(ctx, repo, user_model.NewActionsUser())
335		if err != nil {
336			return perm, err
337		}
338		if botPerm.AccessMode >= perm_model.AccessModeRead {
339			// Public repo allows read access, increase permissions to at least read
340			// Otherwise you cannot access your own repository if your permissions are set to none but the repository is public
341			for _, u := range repo.Units {
342				if botPerm.CanRead(u.Type) {
343					maxPerm.unitsMode[u.Type] = max(maxPerm.unitsMode[u.Type], perm_model.AccessModeRead)
344				}
345			}
346		}
347
348		if task.RepoID == repo.ID {
349			return maxPerm, nil
350		}
351
352		if checkSameOwnerCrossRepoAccess(ctx, taskRepo, repo, task.IsForkPullRequest) {
353			// Access allowed by owner policy (grants access to private repos).
354			// Note: maxPerm has already been restricted to Read-Only in ComputeTaskTokenPermissions
355			// because isSameRepo is false.
356			return maxPerm, nil
357		}
358
359		// Fall through to allow public repository read access via botPerm check below
360
361		// Check if the repo is public or the Bot has explicit access
362		if botPerm.AccessMode >= perm_model.AccessModeRead {
363			return maxPerm, nil
364		}
365
366		// Check Collaborative Owner and explicit Bot permissions
367		// We allow access if:
368		// 1. It's a collaborative owner relationship
369		// 2. The Actions Bot user has been explicitly granted access and repository is private
370		// 3. The repository is public (handled by botPerm above)
371
372		// Fork PRs are never allowed cross-repo access to other private repositories,
373		// matching the discriminator enforced by checkSameOwnerCrossRepoAccess above.
374		if taskRepo.IsPrivate && !task.IsForkPullRequest {
375			actionsUnit := repo.MustGetUnit(ctx, unit.TypeActions)
376			if actionsUnit.ActionsConfig().IsCollaborativeOwner(taskRepo.OwnerID) {
377				return maxPerm, nil
378			}
379		}
380
381		return perm, nil
382	}

385	// dispatching to GetActionsUserRepoPermission when the actor is an Actions token user.
386	func GetDoerRepoPermission(ctx context.Context, repo *repo_model.Repository, user *user_model.User) (Permission, error) {

393	// GetIndividualUserRepoPermission returns the permissions for an explicit user identity.
394	// In most request paths, callers should use GetDoerRepoPermission instead.
395	// Unlike GetDoerRepoPermission, this helper does not resolve Actions task users.
396	func GetIndividualUserRepoPermission(ctx context.Context, repo *repo_model.Repository, user *user_model.User) (perm Permission, err error) {
397		defer func() {
398			if err == nil {
399				finalProcessRepoUnitPermission(user, &perm)
400			}
401			log.Trace("Permission Loaded for user %-v in repo %-v, permissions: %-+v", user, repo, perm)
402		}()
403
404		if err = repo.LoadUnits(ctx); err != nil {
405			return perm, err
406		}
407		perm.units = repo.Units
408
409		// anonymous user visit private repo.
410		if user == nil && repo.IsPrivate {
411			perm.AccessMode = perm_model.AccessModeNone
412			return perm, nil
413		}
414
415		var isCollaborator bool
416		if user != nil {
417			isCollaborator, err = repo_model.IsCollaborator(ctx, repo.ID, user.ID)
418			if err != nil {
419				return perm, err
420			}
421		}
422
423		if err = repo.LoadOwner(ctx); err != nil {
424			return perm, err
425		}
426
427		// Prevent strangers from checking out public repo of private organization/users
428		// Allow user if they are a collaborator of a repo within a private user or a private organization but not a member of the organization itself
429		// TODO: rename it to "IsOwnerVisibleToDoer"
430		if !organization.HasOrgOrUserVisible(ctx, repo.Owner, user) && !isCollaborator {
431			perm.AccessMode = perm_model.AccessModeNone
432			return perm, nil
433		}
434
435		// anonymous visit public repo
436		if user == nil {
437			perm.AccessMode = perm_model.AccessModeRead
438			return perm, nil
439		}
440
441		// Admin or the owner has super access to the repository
442		if user.IsAdmin || user.ID == repo.OwnerID {
443			perm.AccessMode = perm_model.AccessModeOwner
444			return perm, nil
445		}
446
447		// plain user TODO: this check should be replaced, only need to check collaborator access mode
448		perm.AccessMode, err = accessLevel(ctx, user, repo)
449		if err != nil {
450			return perm, err
451		}
452
453		if !repo.Owner.IsOrganization() {
454			return perm, nil
455		}
456
457		// now: the owner is visible to doer, if the repo is public, then the min access mode is read
458		minAccessMode := util.Iif(!repo.IsPrivate && !user.IsRestricted, perm_model.AccessModeRead, perm_model.AccessModeNone)
459		perm.AccessMode = max(perm.AccessMode, minAccessMode)
460
461		// get units mode from teams
462		teams, err := organization.GetUserRepoTeams(ctx, repo.OwnerID, user.ID, repo.ID)
463		if err != nil {
464			return perm, err
465		}
466		if len(teams) == 0 {
467			return perm, nil
468		}
469
470		perm.unitsMode = make(map[unit.Type]perm_model.AccessMode)
471
472		// Collaborators on organization
473		if isCollaborator {
474			for _, u := range repo.Units {
475				perm.unitsMode[u.Type] = perm.AccessMode
476			}
477		}
478
479		// if user in an owner team
480		for _, team := range teams {
481			if team.HasAdminAccess() {
482				perm.AccessMode = perm_model.AccessModeOwner
483				perm.unitsMode = nil
484				return perm, nil
485			}
486		}
487
488		for _, u := range repo.Units {
489			for _, team := range teams {
490				teamMode, _ := team.UnitAccessModeEx(ctx, u.Type)
491				unitAccessMode := max(perm.unitsMode[u.Type], minAccessMode, teamMode)
492				perm.unitsMode[u.Type] = unitAccessMode
493			}
494		}
495
496		return perm, err
497	}
```

```text
22	// Access represents the highest access level of a user to the repository. The only access type
23	// that is not in this table is the real owner of a repository. In case of an organization
24	// repository, the members of the owners team are in this table.
25	type Access struct {
26		ID     int64 `xorm:"pk autoincr"`
27		UserID int64 `xorm:"UNIQUE(s)"`
28		RepoID int64 `xorm:"UNIQUE(s)"`
29		Mode   perm.AccessMode
30	}
31
32	func init() {
33		db.RegisterModel(new(Access))
34	}
35
36	func accessLevel(ctx context.Context, user *user_model.User, repo *repo_model.Repository) (perm.AccessMode, error) {
37		mode := perm.AccessModeNone
38		var userID int64
39		restricted := false
40
41		if user != nil {
42			userID = user.ID
43			restricted = user.IsRestricted
44		}
45
46		if err := repo.LoadOwner(ctx); err != nil {
47			return mode, err
48		}
49
50		repoIsFullyPublic := !setting.Service.RequireSignInViewStrict && repo.Owner.Visibility == structs.VisibleTypePublic && !repo.IsPrivate
51		if (restricted && repoIsFullyPublic) || (!restricted && !repo.IsPrivate) {
52			mode = perm.AccessModeRead
53		}
54
55		if userID == 0 {
56			return mode, nil
57		}
58
59		if userID == repo.OwnerID {
60			return perm.AccessModeOwner, nil
61		}
62
63		a, exist, err := db.Get[Access](ctx, builder.Eq{"user_id": userID, "repo_id": repo.ID})
64		if err != nil {
65			return mode, err
66		} else if !exist {
67			return mode, nil
68		}
69		return a.Mode, nil
70	}
71

75			maxMode = max(maxMode, mode)
```

```text
    29		results := make(map[int64]bool, len(users))
    30		for _, user := range users {
    31			results[user.ID] = false // Set default to false
    32		}

    34		if tokenMaps, err := users.loadTwoFactorStatus(ctx); err == nil {

199 // DisableTwoFactor removes every two-factor method of the given user atomically,
200 // returning the number of TOTP records and WebAuthn credentials removed.
201 // It is a no-op for a user that has no 2FA enrolled.
202 func DisableTwoFactor(ctx context.Context, uid int64) (totp, webAuthn int64, err error) {
203 err = db.WithTx(ctx, func(ctx context.Context) error {
204 var e error

207 }
```

```text
180 // FindOrgMembersOpts represents find org members conditions
181 type FindOrgMembersOpts struct {
182 db.ListOptions
183 Doer *user_model.User
184 IsDoerMember bool
185 OrgID int64
186 Keyword string
187 }
188
189 func (opts FindOrgMembersOpts) PublicOnly() bool {
190 return opts.Doer == nil || !(opts.IsDoerMember || opts.Doer.IsAdmin)
191 }
192
193 // applyKeywordFilter adds keyword search conditions to session
194 func (opts FindOrgMembersOpts) applyKeywordFilter(sess db.Session) bool {
195 if opts.Keyword == "" {
196 return false
197 }
198
199 keywordCond := builder.Or(
200 db.BuildCaseInsensitiveLike("`user`.lower_name", opts.Keyword),
201 db.BuildCaseInsensitiveLike("`user`.full_name", opts.Keyword),
202 )
203
204 emailCond := db.BuildCaseInsensitiveLike("`user`.email", opts.Keyword)
205 switch {
206 case opts.Doer == nil:
207 emailCond = emailCond.And(builder.Eq{"`user`.keep_email_private": false})
208 case !opts.Doer.IsAdmin:
209 emailCond = emailCond.And(
210 builder.Or(
211 builder.Eq{"`user`.keep_email_private": false},
212 builder.Eq{"`user`.id": opts.Doer.ID},
213 ),
214 )
215 }
216 keywordCond = keywordCond.Or(emailCond)
217
218 _ = sess.Join("INNER", "`user`", "org_user.uid = `user`.id").And(keywordCond)
219 return true
220 }
221
222 // applyTeamMatesOnlyFilter make sure restricted users only see public team members and there own team mates
223 func (opts FindOrgMembersOpts) applyTeamMatesOnlyFilter(sess db.Session) {
224 if opts.Doer != nil && opts.IsDoerMember && opts.Doer.IsRestricted {
225 teamMates := builder.Select("DISTINCT team_user.uid").
226 From("team_user").
227 Where(builder.In("team_user.team_id", getUserTeamIDsQueryBuilder(opts.OrgID, opts.Doer.ID))).
228 And(builder.Eq{"team_user.org_id": opts.OrgID})
229
230 sess.And(
231 builder.In("org_user.uid", teamMates).
232 Or(builder.Eq{"org_user.is_public": true}),
233 )
234 }
235 }
236
237 // CountOrgMembers counts the organization's members
238 func CountOrgMembers(ctx context.Context, opts *FindOrgMembersOpts) (int64, error) {
239 sess := db.GetEngine(ctx).Where("org_id=?", opts.OrgID)
240 if opts.PublicOnly() {
241 sess = sess.And("is_public = ?", true)
242 } else {
243 opts.applyTeamMatesOnlyFilter(sess)
244 }
245 _ = opts.applyKeywordFilter(sess)
246
247 return sess.Count(new(OrgUser))
248 }
249
250 // FindOrgMembers loads organization members according conditions
251 func FindOrgMembers(ctx context.Context, opts *FindOrgMembersOpts) (user_model.UserList, map[int64]bool, error) {
252 ous, err := GetOrgUsersByOrgID(ctx, opts)
253 if err != nil {
254 return nil, nil, err
255 }
256
257 ids := make([]int64, len(ous))
258 idsIsPublic := make(map[int64]bool, len(ous))
259 for i, ou := range ous {
260 ids[i] = ou.UID
261 idsIsPublic[ou.UID] = ou.IsPublic
262 }
263
264 users, err := user_model.GetUsersByIDs(ctx, ids)
265 if err != nil {
266 return nil, nil, err
267 }
268 return users, idsIsPublic, nil
269 }

272 func (org *Organization) AsUser() *user_model.User {
273 return (*user_model.User)(org)
274 }
```

```text
// TestOAuth2AutoLinkWithTwoFactor verifies that automatic account linking completes
// after the user passes local 2FA when an OIDC identity matches an existing account.
func TestOAuth2AutoLinkWithTwoFactor(t *testing.T) {
	defer tests.PrepareTestEnv(t)()
	defer test.MockVariableValue(&setting.OAuth2Client.EnableAutoRegistration, true)()
	defer test.MockVariableValue(&setting.OAuth2Client.AccountLinking, setting.OAuth2AccountLinkingAuto)()
	defer test.MockVariableValue(&setting.OAuth2Client.Username, setting.OAuth2UsernameEmail)()

	const (
		sourceName = "test-oauth-auto-link-2fa"
		sub        = "oidc-auto-link-2fa-sub"
		email      = "oidc-auto-link-2fa@example.com"
		userName   = "oidc-auto-link-2fa"
	)

	srv := newFakeOIDCServer(t, FakeOIDCConfig{Sub: sub, Email: email, Name: "OIDC Auto Link 2FA"})
	addOAuth2Source(t, sourceName, oauth2.Source{
		Provider:                      "openidConnect",
		ClientID:                      "test-client-id",
		ClientSecret:                  "test-client-secret",
		OpenIDConnectAutoDiscoveryURL: srv.URL + "/.well-known/openid-configuration",
	})
	authSource, err := auth_model.GetActiveOAuth2SourceByAuthName(t.Context(), sourceName)
	require.NoError(t, err)

	localUser := &user_model.User{Name: userName, Email: email}
	require.NoError(t, user_model.CreateUser(t.Context(), localUser, &user_model.Meta{}))

	otpKey, err := totp.Generate(totp.GenerateOpts{
		SecretSize:  40,
		Issuer:      "gitea-test",
		AccountName: localUser.Name,
	})
	require.NoError(t, err)

	tfa := &auth_model.TwoFactor{UID: localUser.ID}
	require.NoError(t, tfa.SetSecret(otpKey.Secret()))
	require.NoError(t, auth_model.NewTwoFactor(t.Context(), tfa))

	unittest.AssertNotExistsBean(t, &user_model.ExternalLoginUser{ExternalID: sub, LoginSourceID: authSource.ID}, unittest.OrderBy("external_id ASC"))

	session := emptyTestSession(t)
	resp := session.MakeRequest(t, NewRequest(t, "GET", "/user/oauth2/"+sourceName), http.StatusTemporaryRedirect)

	location := resp.Header().Get("Location")
	u, err := url.Parse(location)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	state := u.Query().Get("state")
	require.NotEmpty(t, state)

	callbackURL := fmt.Sprintf("/user/oauth2/%s/callback?code=test-code&state=%s", sourceName, url.QueryEscape(state))
	resp = session.MakeRequest(t, NewRequest(t, "GET", callbackURL), http.StatusSeeOther)
	assert.Contains(t, resp.Header().Get("Location"), "/user/two_factor")

	session.MakeRequest(t, NewRequest(t, "GET", "/user/two_factor"), http.StatusOK)

	passcode, err := totp.GenerateCode(otpKey.Secret(), time.Now())
	require.NoError(t, err)

	req := NewRequestWithValues(t, "POST", "/user/two_factor", map[string]string{
		"passcode": passcode,
	})
	session.MakeRequest(t, req, http.StatusSeeOther)

	externalLink := unittest.AssertExistsAndLoadBean(t, &user_model.ExternalLoginUser{ExternalID: sub, LoginSourceID: authSource.ID}, unittest.OrderBy("external_id ASC"))
	assert.Equal(t, localUser.ID, externalLink.UserID)

	session.MakeRequest(t, NewRequest(t, "GET", "/user/settings"), http.StatusOK)
}
```

```text
---
scope: models/migrations
verified-at: 773c614f56
---

# models/migrations — versioned schema changes

**Read when:** you changed a persisted struct under `models/`, or a migration test fails.
**Not here:** the runtime engine -> `models-db.md`; running the suite -> `testing.md`.

## Responsibilities

An ordered, append-only list of schema migrations. Each has an integer id; the database records how
far it has got, and startup applies whatever is missing. `services/versioned_migration` is what
invokes this at boot.

## Key files

| Path | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `models/migrations/migrations.go` | the ordered slice, `newMigration`, `minDBVersion`, `Migrate`, `EnsureUpToDate`, `GetCurrentDBVersion`, `ExpectedDBVersion` |
| `models/migrations/v1_27/v343.go` | a minimal add-columns migration — the shape to copy |
| `models/migrations/base/db.go` | `RecreateTable`, `RecreateTables`, `DropTableColumns`, `ModifyColumn` |
| `models/migrations/migrationtest/tests.go` | `PrepareTestEnv`, `MainTest` for migration tests |
| `models/migrations/fixtures/Test_<FuncName>/` | per-test fixture directory, named after the test |

## Conventions & invariants

- A migration is one `newMigration(<id>, "<description>", v1_27.FuncName)` entry **appended at the
  bottom** of the slice in `migrations.go`. Order is the schema history; never insert in the
  middle, never renumber.
- The implementation lives in the current version subpackage as `v<id>.go` — migration 342 is
  `models/migrations/v1_27/v342.go` — with the function exported and named for what it does.
- Signature is `func(x db.EngineMigration) error`, or with a leading `context.Context` when the
  migration needs one. `newMigration` accepts either.
- The database version is *the last migration's id + 1*. `minDBVersion` is 70 (Gitea 1.5.3):
  installs older than that must upgrade through an intermediate release first.
- **A migration declares its own local copy of every struct it touches, inside the function**, with
  only the columns it cares about. `v342.go` declares a local `ActionRun` holding just the three
  new columns. Never import the live model from `models/` — the model keeps evolving, and a
  migration must describe the schema *as of its own moment* forever.
- Partial table changes use `x.SyncWithOptions(xorm.SyncOptions{IgnoreDropIndices: true,
  IgnoreConstrains: true}, new(Foo))` rather than plain `Sync`, so unrelated indices and
  constraints survive (`docs/guidelines-backend.md`).
- A column added to an existing table takes `NOT NULL DEFAULT <value>`
  (`models/migrations/v1_27/v343.go`): the default fills existing rows in the same `ALTER TABLE`.
  Without it the column is nullable and old rows hold NULL (`models/migrations/v1_27/v332.go`),
  which `WHERE col = 0` does not match. `NOT NULL` with no default fails on a populated table.
- New `.go` files carry a copyright header with the current year (`AGENTS.md`).

## Recipes

**Add a migration.**

1. Change the real struct in its `models/<domain>/` package.
2. Create `models/migrations/v1_27/v<next id>.go` with an exported function and a local struct copy
   holding only the affected columns.
3. Append `newMigration(<next id>, "<description>", v1_27.FuncName)` to the bottom of the slice in
   `migrations.go`.
4. Add `v<next id>_test.go` beside it, using `migrationtest.PrepareTestEnv`; put any fixtures in
   `models/migrations/fixtures/Test_<FuncName>/`.
5. `make test-migration`.

**Change a column type or drop columns.** Use `base.ModifyColumn` or `base.DropTableColumns` rather
than raw SQL — they handle the per-driver differences. `base.RecreateTable` is the last resort for
changes some drivers cannot express.

## Gotchas

- **Never edit a migration that has shipped.** Installs that already ran it will not run it again,
  so the edit silently applies to new installs only and the two diverge. Add a new migration.
- Registering a model with `db.RegisterModel` creates the table on a *fresh* install only. Existing
  installs need the migration — this is the most common way a change works locally and breaks on
  upgrade.
- Migration tests use their own harness (`migrationtest`), not `models/unittest`. The fixture
  directory name must match the test function name exactly or no fixtures load.
- `migrationtest` loads fixtures through `models/unittest/fixtures_loader.go` → `NewFixturesLoader`,
  which skips, without an error, any table whose model is not registered. Blank-import the owning
  package and assert the row count, as `models/migrations/v1_27/v343_test.go` does.
- `make test-migration` is a separate target from `make test-backend`; a migration can be broken
  while the backend suite is green.
- `go test ./models/...` runs the migration packages in parallel, but they share one repository
  directory (`models/migrations/migrationtest/tests.go` → `PrepareTestEnv`), so old tests fail at
  random with missing-directory errors. `make migrations.individual.test` runs them with `-p 1`.

## Related

- `models-db.md` — `db.RegisterModel` and the engine
- `testing.md` — the other four test tiers
```

```text
package v1_27
import (
	"context"
	"gitea.dev/models/db"
	"xorm.io/xorm/schemas"
)
// AddCreatedUnixToActionUserIsDeletedIndex extends the c_u composite index on
// the action table to include created_unix, enabling efficient ORDER BY on the
// dashboard feed query without a full sort of all matching rows.
func AddCreatedUnixToActionUserIsDeletedIndex(x db.EngineMigration) error {
	// xorm Sync cannot reliably update an index when another index already
	// covers the same columns in a different order (Equal() is order-insensitive).
	// Drop the old c_u index explicitly, then recreate it with the new column set.
	indexes, err := x.Dialect().GetIndexes(x.DB(), context.Background(), "action")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for _, idx := range indexes {
		if idx.Name == "c_u" {
			if _, err := x.Exec(x.Dialect().DropIndexSQL("action", idx)); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			break
		}
	}
	newIndex := schemas.NewIndex("c_u", schemas.IndexType)
	newIndex.AddColumn("user_id", "is_deleted", "created_unix")
	if _, err := x.Exec(x.Dialect().CreateIndexSQL("action", newIndex)); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return nil
}

	}, new(ActionRun))
```

```text
    27	// Create render the page for create organization
    28	func Create(ctx *context.Context) {
    29		ctx.Data["Title"] = ctx.Tr("new_org")
    30		if !ctx.Doer.CanCreateOrganization() {
    31			ctx.ServerError("Not allowed", errors.New(ctx.Locale.TrString("org.form.create_org_not_allowed")))
    32			return
    33		}
    34
    35		ctx.Data["visibility"] = setting.Service.DefaultOrgVisibilityMode
    36		ctx.Data["repo_admin_change_team_access"] = true
    37
    38		ctx.HTML(http.StatusOK, tplCreateOrg)
    39	}
    40
    41	// CreatePost response for create organization
    42	func CreatePost(ctx *context.Context) {
    43		form := *web.GetForm(ctx).(*forms.CreateOrgForm)
    44		ctx.Data["Title"] = ctx.Tr("new_org")
    45
    46		if !ctx.Doer.CanCreateOrganization() {
    47			ctx.ServerError("Not allowed", errors.New(ctx.Locale.TrString("org.form.create_org_not_allowed")))
    48			return
    49		}
    50
    51		if ctx.HasError() {
    52			ctx.HTML(http.StatusOK, tplCreateOrg)
    53			return
    54		}
    55
    56		org := &organization.Organization{

    59			Type:                      user_model.UserTypeOrganization,
    60			Visibility:                form.Visibility,

    63
    64		if err := organization.CreateOrganization(ctx, org, ctx.Doer); err != nil {
    65			ctx.Data["Err_OrgName"] = true
    66			switch {

    68				ctx.RenderWithErrDeprecated(ctx.Tr("form.org_name_been_taken"), tplCreateOrg, &form)
```

```text
}

// TwoFactorPost validates a user's two-factor authentication token.
func TwoFactorPost(ctx *context.Context) {
	form := web.GetForm(ctx).(*forms.TwoFactorAuthForm)
	ctx.Data["Title"] = ctx.Tr("twofa")

	// Ensure user is in a 2FA session.
	idSess := ctx.Session.Get("twofaUid")
	if idSess == nil {
		ctx.ServerError("UserSignIn", errors.New("not in 2FA session"))
		return
	}

	id := idSess.(int64)
	twofa, err := auth.GetTwoFactorByUID(ctx, id)
	if err != nil {
		ctx.ServerError("UserSignIn", err)
		return
	}

	// Validate the passcode and atomically consume it to prevent reuse/replay.
	ok, err := twofa.ValidateAndConsumeTOTP(ctx, form.Passcode)
	if err != nil {
		ctx.ServerError("UserSignIn", err)
		return
	}

	if ok {
		remember := ctx.Session.Get("twofaRemember").(bool)
		u, err := user_model.GetUserByID(ctx, id)
		if err != nil {
			ctx.ServerError("UserSignIn", err)
			return
		}

		if ctx.Session.Get("linkAccount") != nil {
			err = linkAccountFromContext(ctx, u)
			if err != nil {
				ctx.ServerError("UserSignIn", err)
				return
			}
		}

		_ = ctx.Session.Set(session.KeyUserHasTwoFactorAuth, true)
		handleSignIn(ctx, u, remember)
		return
	}

	ctx.RenderWithErrDeprecated(ctx.Tr("auth.twofa_passcode_incorrect"), tplTwofa, forms.TwoFactorAuthForm{})
}
```

```text
// HasOrgOrUserVisible tells if the given user can see the given org or user
func HasOrgOrUserVisible(ctx context.Context, orgOrUser, user *user_model.User) bool {
	// If user is nil, it's an anonymous user/request.
	// The Ghost user is handled like an anonymous user.
	if user == nil || user.IsGhost() {
		return orgOrUser.Visibility == structs.VisibleTypePublic
	}

	if user.IsAdmin || orgOrUser.ID == user.ID {
		return true
	}

	if !setting.Service.RequireSignInViewStrict && orgOrUser.Visibility == structs.VisibleTypePublic {
		return true
	}

	if (orgOrUser.Visibility == structs.VisibleTypePrivate || user.IsRestricted) && !OrgFromUser(orgOrUser).hasMemberWithUserID(ctx, user.ID) {
		return false
	}
	return true
```
```text
}

func onGiteaRun[T testing.TB](t T, callback func(T, *url.URL)) {
	defer tests.PrepareTestEnv(t, 1)()
	s := http.Server{
		Handler: testWebRoutes,
	}

	u, err := url.Parse(setting.AppURL)
	assert.NoError(t, err)
	listener, err := net.Listen("tcp", u.Host)
	i := 0
	for err != nil && i <= 10 {
		time.Sleep(100 * time.Millisecond)
		listener, err = net.Listen("tcp", u.Host)
		i++
	}
	assert.NoError(t, err)
	u.Host = listener.Addr().String()

	defer func() {
		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(t.Context(), 2*time.Minute)
		s.Shutdown(ctx)
		cancel()
	}()

	go s.Serve(listener)
	// Started by config go ssh.Listen(setting.SSH.ListenHost, setting.SSH.ListenPort, setting.SSH.ServerCiphers, setting.SSH.ServerKeyExchanges, setting.SSH.ServerMACs)

	callback(t, u)
}
```

```text
125				// No explicit access record needed (handled by default permissions, e.g., public repo access)
126				if _, exists := existingMap[userID]; exists {
127					toDelete = append(toDelete, userID)
128				}
129			} else {
130				desiredMode := ua.Mode
131				if existingMode, exists := existingMap[userID]; exists {
132					if existingMode != desiredMode {
133						toUpdate = append(toUpdate, Access{UserID: userID, RepoID: repo.ID, Mode: desiredMode})
134					}
135				} else {
136					toInsert = append(toInsert, Access{UserID: userID, RepoID: repo.ID, Mode: desiredMode})
137				}
138			}
139			delete(existingMap, userID)
140		}
141
142		// Remaining in existingMap should be deleted
143		for userID := range existingMap {
144			toDelete = append(toDelete, userID)
145		}
146
147		// Execute deletions
148		if len(toDelete) > 0 {
149			if _, err = db.GetEngine(ctx).In("user_id", toDelete).And("repo_id = ?", repo.ID).Delete(&Access{}); err != nil {
150				return fmt.Errorf("delete accesses: %w", err)
151			}
152		}
153
154		// Execute updates
155		for _, u := range toUpdate {
156			if _, err = db.GetEngine(ctx).Where("user_id = ? AND repo_id = ?", u.UserID, repo.ID).Cols("mode").Update(&Access{Mode: u.Mode}); err != nil {
157				return fmt.Errorf("update access for user %d: %w", u.UserID, err)
158			}
159		}
160
161		// Execute insertions
162		if len(toInsert) > 0 {
163			if err = db.Insert(ctx, toInsert); err != nil {
164				return fmt.Errorf("insert new accesses: %w", err)
165			}
166		}
167
168		return nil
169	}
170
171	// refreshCollaboratorAccesses retrieves repository collaborations with their access modes.
172	func refreshCollaboratorAccesses(ctx context.Context, repoID int64, accessMap map[int64]*userAccess) error {
173		collaborators, _, err := repo_model.GetCollaborators(ctx, &repo_model.FindCollaborationOptions{RepoID: repoID})
174		if err != nil {
175			return fmt.Errorf("GetCollaborators: %w", err)
176		}
177		for _, c := range collaborators {
178			if c.User.IsGhost() {
179				continue
180			}
181			updateUserAccess(accessMap, c.User, c.Collaboration.Mode)
182		}
183		return nil
184	}
185
186	// RecalculateTeamAccesses recalculates new accesses for teams of an organization
187	// except the team whose ID is given. It is used to assign a team ID when
188	// remove repository from that team.
189	func RecalculateTeamAccesses(ctx context.Context, repo *repo_model.Repository, ignTeamID int64) (err error) {
190		accessMap := make(map[int64]*userAccess, 20)
191
192		if err = repo.LoadOwner(ctx); err != nil {
193			return err
194		} else if !repo.Owner.IsOrganization() {
195			return fmt.Errorf("owner is not an organization: %d", repo.OwnerID)
196		}
197
198		if err = refreshCollaboratorAccesses(ctx, repo.ID, accessMap); err != nil {
199			return fmt.Errorf("refreshCollaboratorAccesses: %w", err)
200		}
201
202		teams, err := organization.FindOrgTeams(ctx, repo.Owner.ID)
203		if err != nil {
204			return err
205		}
206
207		for _, t := range teams {
208			if t.ID == ignTeamID {
209				continue
210			}
211
212			// Owner team gets owner access, and skip for teams that do not
213			// have relations with repository.
214			if t.IsOwnerTeam() {
215				t.AccessMode = perm.AccessModeOwner
216			} else if !organization.HasTeamRepo(ctx, t.OrgID, t.ID, repo.ID) {
217				continue
218			}
219
220			if err = t.LoadMembers(ctx); err != nil {
221				return fmt.Errorf("getMembers '%d': %w", t.ID, err)
222			}
223			for _, m := range t.Members {
224				updateUserAccess(accessMap, m, t.AccessMode)
225			}
226		}
227
228		return refreshAccesses(ctx, repo, accessMap)
229	}
```

```text
func mapForm(formStruct reflect.Value, form map[string][]string,
	formfile map[string][]*multipart.FileHeader, errors Errors,
) Errors {
	if formStruct.Kind() == reflect.Ptr {
		formStruct = formStruct.Elem()
	}
	typ := formStruct.Type()

	for i := 0; i < typ.NumField(); i++ {
		typeField := typ.Field(i)
		structField := formStruct.Field(i)

		if typeField.Type.Kind() == reflect.Ptr && typeField.Anonymous {
			structField.Set(reflect.New(typeField.Type.Elem()))
			errors = mapForm(structField.Elem(), form, formfile, errors)
			if reflect.DeepEqual(structField.Elem().Interface(), reflect.Zero(structField.Elem().Type()).Interface()) {
				structField.Set(reflect.Zero(structField.Type()))
			}
		} else if typeField.Type.Kind() == reflect.Struct {
			errors = mapForm(structField, form, formfile, errors)
		}

		inputFieldName := parseFormName(typeField.Name, typeField.Tag.Get("form"))
		if len(inputFieldName) == 0 || !structField.CanSet() {
			continue
		}

		inputValue, exists := form[inputFieldName]
		if exists {
			numElems := len(inputValue)
			if structField.Kind() == reflect.Slice && numElems > 0 {
				sliceOf := structField.Type().Elem().Kind()
				slice := reflect.MakeSlice(structField.Type(), numElems, numElems)
				for i := 0; i < numElems; i++ {
					errors = setWithProperType(sliceOf, inputValue[i], slice.Index(i), inputFieldName, errors)
				}
				formStruct.Field(i).Set(slice)
			} else {
				errors = setWithProperType(typeField.Type.Kind(), inputValue[0], structField, inputFieldName, errors)
			}
			continue
		}

		inputFile, exists := formfile[inputFieldName]
		if !exists {
			continue
		}
		fhType := reflect.TypeOf((*multipart.FileHeader)(nil))
		numElems := len(inputFile)
		if structField.Kind() == reflect.Slice && numElems > 0 && structField.Type().Elem() == fhType {
			slice := reflect.MakeSlice(structField.Type(), numElems, numElems)
			for i := 0; i < numElems; i++ {
				slice.Index(i).Set(reflect.ValueOf(inputFile[i]))
			}
			structField.Set(slice)
		} else if structField.Type() == fhType {
			structField.Set(reflect.ValueOf(inputFile[0]))
		}
	}
	return errors
}

// This sets the value in a struct of an indeterminate type to the
// matching value from the request (via Form middleware) in the
// same type, so that not all deserialized values have to be strings.
// Supported types are string, int, float, bool, and ptr of these types.
func setWithProperType(valueKind reflect.Kind, val string, structField reflect.Value, nameInTag string, errors Errors) Errors {
	switch valueKind {
	case reflect.Int, reflect.Int8, reflect.Int16, reflect.Int32, reflect.Int64:
		if val == "" {
			val = "0"
		}
		intVal, err := strconv.ParseInt(val, 10, 64)
		if err != nil {
			errors.Add([]string{nameInTag}, ERR_INTERGER_TYPE, "Value could not be parsed as integer")
		} else {
			structField.SetInt(intVal)
		}
	case reflect.Uint, reflect.Uint8, reflect.Uint16, reflect.Uint32, reflect.Uint64:
		if val == "" {
			val = "0"
		}
		uintVal, err := strconv.ParseUint(val, 10, 64)
		if err != nil {
			errors.Add([]string{nameInTag}, ERR_INTERGER_TYPE, "Value could not be parsed as unsigned integer")
		} else {
			structField.SetUint(uintVal)
		}
	case reflect.Bool:
		if val == "on" {
			structField.SetBool(true)
			break
		}

		if val == "" {
			val = "false"
		}
		boolVal, err := strconv.ParseBool(val)
		if err != nil {
			errors.Add([]string{nameInTag}, ERR_BOOLEAN_TYPE, "Value could not be parsed as boolean")
		} else if boolVal {
			structField.SetBool(true)
		}
	case reflect.Float32:
		if val == "" {
			val = "0.0"
		}
		floatVal, err := strconv.ParseFloat(val, 32)
		if err != nil {
			errors.Add([]string{nameInTag}, ERR_FLOAT_TYPE, "Value could not be parsed as 32-bit float")
		} else {
			structField.SetFloat(floatVal)
		}
	case reflect.Float64:
		if val == "" {
			val = "0.0"
		}
		floatVal, err := strconv.ParseFloat(val, 64)
		if err != nil {
			errors.Add([]string{nameInTag}, ERR_FLOAT_TYPE, "Value could not be parsed as 64-bit float")
		} else {
			structField.SetFloat(floatVal)
		}
	case reflect.String:
		structField.SetString(val)
	case reflect.Ptr:
		newVal := reflect.New(structField.Type().Elem())
		errors = setWithProperType(structField.Type().Elem().Kind(), val, newVal.Elem(), nameInTag, errors)
		structField.Set(newVal)
	}
	return errors
}
```

```text
// Copyright 2024 The Gitea Authors. All rights reserved.
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT

package access

import (
	"testing"

	actions_model "gitea.dev/models/actions"
	"gitea.dev/models/db"
	"gitea.dev/models/organization"
	perm_model "gitea.dev/models/perm"
	repo_model "gitea.dev/models/repo"
	"gitea.dev/models/unit"
	"gitea.dev/models/unittest"
	user_model "gitea.dev/models/user"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)
			unit.TypeWiki: perm_model.AccessModeRead,
		},
	}
	assert.Equal(t, perm_model.AccessModeRead, perm.UnitAccessMode(unit.TypeWiki), "has unit, and map, use map")
}

func TestGetRepoPermission(t *testing.T) {
	require.NoError(t, unittest.PrepareTestDatabase())
	t.Run("GetIndividualUserRepoPermission", testGetIndividualUserRepoPermission)
	t.Run("GetDoerRepoPermission", testGetDoerRepoPermission)
}

func testGetIndividualUserRepoPermission(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := t.Context()
	repo32 := unittest.AssertExistsAndLoadBean(t, &repo_model.Repository{ID: 32}) // org public repo
	require.NoError(t, repo32.LoadOwner(ctx))
	require.True(t, repo32.Owner.IsOrganization())

	require.NoError(t, db.TruncateBeans(ctx, &organization.Team{}, &organization.TeamUser{}, &organization.TeamRepo{}, &organization.TeamUnit{}))
	org := repo32.Owner
	user := unittest.AssertExistsAndLoadBean(t, &user_model.User{ID: 4})
	team := &organization.Team{OrgID: org.ID, LowerName: "test_team"}
	require.NoError(t, db.Insert(ctx, team))
	require.NoError(t, db.Insert(ctx, &organization.TeamUser{OrgID: org.ID, TeamID: team.ID, UID: user.ID}))

	t.Run("DoerInTeamWithNoRepo", func(t *testing.T) {
		perm, err := GetIndividualUserRepoPermission(ctx, repo32, user)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		assert.Equal(t, perm_model.AccessModeRead, perm.AccessMode)
		assert.Nil(t, perm.unitsMode) // doer in the team, but has no access to the repo
	})

	require.NoError(t, db.Insert(ctx, &organization.TeamRepo{OrgID: org.ID, TeamID: team.ID, RepoID: repo32.ID}))
	require.NoError(t, db.Insert(ctx, &organization.TeamUnit{OrgID: org.ID, TeamID: team.ID, Type: unit.TypeCode, AccessMode: perm_model.AccessModeNone}))
	t.Run("DoerWithTeamUnitAccessNone", func(t *testing.T) {
		perm, err := GetIndividualUserRepoPermission(ctx, repo32, user)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		assert.Equal(t, perm_model.AccessModeRead, perm.AccessMode)
		assert.Equal(t, perm_model.AccessModeRead, perm.unitsMode[unit.TypeCode])
		assert.Equal(t, perm_model.AccessModeRead, perm.unitsMode[unit.TypeIssues])
	})

	require.NoError(t, db.TruncateBeans(ctx, &organization.TeamUnit{}))
	require.NoError(t, db.Insert(ctx, &organization.TeamUnit{OrgID: org.ID, TeamID: team.ID, Type: unit.TypeCode, AccessMode: perm_model.AccessModeWrite}))
	t.Run("DoerWithTeamUnitAccessWrite", func(t *testing.T) {
		perm, err := GetIndividualUserRepoPermission(ctx, repo32, user)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		assert.Equal(t, perm_model.AccessModeRead, perm.AccessMode)
		assert.Equal(t, perm_model.AccessModeWrite, perm.unitsMode[unit.TypeCode])
		assert.Equal(t, perm_model.AccessModeRead, perm.unitsMode[unit.TypeIssues])
	})

	repo3 := unittest.AssertExistsAndLoadBean(t, &repo_model.Repository{ID: 3}) // org private repo, same org as repo 32
	require.NoError(t, repo3.LoadOwner(ctx))
	require.True(t, repo3.Owner.IsOrganization())
	require.NoError(t, db.TruncateBeans(ctx, &organization.TeamUnit{}, &Access{})) // The user has access set of that repo, remove it, it is useless for our test
	require.NoError(t, db.Insert(ctx, &organization.TeamRepo{OrgID: org.ID, TeamID: team.ID, RepoID: repo3.ID}))
	t.Run("DoerWithNoopTeamOnPrivateRepo", func(t *testing.T) {
		perm, err := GetIndividualUserRepoPermission(ctx, repo3, user)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		assert.Equal(t, perm_model.AccessModeNone, perm.AccessMode)
		assert.Equal(t, perm_model.AccessModeNone, perm.unitsMode[unit.TypeCode])
		assert.Equal(t, perm_model.AccessModeNone, perm.unitsMode[unit.TypeIssues])
	})

	require.NoError(t, db.Insert(ctx, &organization.TeamUnit{OrgID: org.ID, TeamID: team.ID, Type: unit.TypeCode, AccessMode: perm_model.AccessModeNone}))
	require.NoError(t, db.Insert(ctx, &organization.TeamUnit{OrgID: org.ID, TeamID: team.ID, Type: unit.TypeIssues, AccessMode: perm_model.AccessModeRead}))
	t.Run("DoerWithReadIssueTeamOnPrivateRepo", func(t *testing.T) {
		perm, err := GetIndividualUserRepoPermission(ctx, repo3, user)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		assert.Equal(t, perm_model.AccessModeNone, perm.AccessMode)
		assert.Equal(t, perm_model.AccessModeNone, perm.unitsMode[unit.TypeCode])
		assert.Equal(t, perm_model.AccessModeRead, perm.unitsMode[unit.TypeIssues])

		users, err := GetUsersWithUnitAccess(ctx, repo3, perm_model.AccessModeRead, unit.TypeIssues)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		require.Len(t, users, 1)
		assert.Equal(t, user.ID, users[0].ID)

		users, err = GetUsersWithUnitAccess(ctx, repo3, perm_model.AccessModeWrite, unit.TypeIssues)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		require.Empty(t, users)
	})

	require.NoError(t, db.Insert(ctx, repo_model.Collaboration{RepoID: repo3.ID, UserID: user.ID, Mode: perm_model.AccessModeWrite}))
	require.NoError(t, db.Insert(ctx, Access{RepoID: repo3.ID, UserID: user.ID, Mode: perm_model.AccessModeWrite}))
	t.Run("DoerWithReadIssueTeamAndWriteCollaboratorOnPrivateRepo", func(t *testing.T) {
		perm, err := GetIndividualUserRepoPermission(ctx, repo3, user)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		assert.Equal(t, perm_model.AccessModeWrite, perm.AccessMode)
		assert.Equal(t, perm_model.AccessModeWrite, perm.unitsMode[unit.TypeCode])
		assert.Equal(t, perm_model.AccessModeWrite, perm.unitsMode[unit.TypeIssues])

		users, err := GetUsersWithUnitAccess(ctx, repo3, perm_model.AccessModeWrite, unit.TypeIssues)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		require.Len(t, users, 1)
		assert.Equal(t, user.ID, users[0].ID)
	})
}

func testGetDoerRepoPermission(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := t.Context()

	repo4 := unittest.AssertExistsAndLoadBean(t, &repo_model.Repository{ID: 4})
	repo1 := unittest.AssertExistsAndLoadBean(t, &repo_model.Repository{ID: 1})
	task47 := unittest.AssertExistsAndLoadBean(t, &actions_model.ActionTask{ID: 47})
	actionsDoer := user_model.NewActionsUserWithTaskID(task47.ID)
	regularUser := unittest.AssertExistsAndLoadBean(t, &user_model.User{ID: 2})

	actionsPerm, err := GetDoerRepoPermission(ctx, repo4, actionsDoer)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	directPerm, err := GetActionsUserRepoPermission(ctx, repo4, actionsDoer, task47.ID)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	assert.Equal(t, directPerm, actionsPerm)

	doerPerm, err := GetDoerRepoPermission(ctx, repo1, regularUser)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	individualPerm, err := GetIndividualUserRepoPermission(ctx, repo1, regularUser)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	assert.Equal(t, individualPerm, doerPerm)
}
```

<tool-use data-tool-type="generic" data-tool-name="AskUserQuestion"><details>
<summary>Tool use: **AskUserQuestion**</summary>
**When an owner turns on "Require 2FA", what should happen to members who haven't enrolled yet?**

Options:
- **Reversible lockout (Recommended)** - Members without 2FA are treated as non-members of the org on every path (web, API, git, SSH): they lose private repos and member-only pages, but stay in the org. Enrolling restores access straight away. No membership is deleted. This is the smallest build and fits the Oct 8 deadline.
- **Read-only** - Members without 2FA keep read access but lose write/admin. Less disruptive, but secrets stay readable, which is the main risk the issue names. Every permission level also needs its own clamping rule.
- **Grace period** - Members get N days before the lockout starts. Needs an extra 'enforced since' column, a countdown in the UI and time-based tests. This is realistic for a 1-day build only if it's a fixed number of days.

**Who should the policy cover?**

Options:
- **Members + collaborators (Recommended)** - Anyone whose access to the org's repos comes from the org: team members and outside collaborators on its repos. This matches GitHub and the issue's goal that 'everyone with access to our code' must use 2FA. Site admins are exempt.
- **Org members only** - Only users in the org's teams. Outside collaborators added to a single repo keep access without 2FA, so the 'one reused [REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]]' risk remains for them.


**Answer:** Ignore any deadlines for implementation, stay within the issues requests., Members + collaborators (Recommended)". Read the answers carefully — they may request clarification, changes, or that you not proceed — and follow what they actually say.

```text
func TestIsUserOrgOwner(t *testing.T) {
	assert.NoError(t, unittest.PrepareTestDatabase())

	tt := []struct {
		uid      int64
		orgid    int64
		expected bool
	}{
		{2, 3, true},
		{4, 3, false},
		{5, 6, true},
		{5, 7, true},
	}
	for _, v := range tt {
		t.Run(fmt.Sprintf("UserId%dIsOrgOwnerOf%d", v.uid, v.orgid), func(t *testing.T) {
			testIsUserOrgOwner(t, v.uid, v.orgid, v.expected)
		})
	}
}

func testIsUserOrgOwner(t *testing.T, uid, orgID int64, expected bool) {
	user, err := user_model.GetUserByID(t.Context(), uid)
	assert.NoError(t, err)
	is, err := organization.IsOrganizationOwner(t.Context(), orgID, user.ID)
	assert.NoError(t, err)
	assert.Equal(t, expected, is)
}
```

```text
// loadPusherAndPermission returns false if an error occurs, and it writes the error response
func (ctx *preReceiveContext) loadPusherAndPermission() bool {
	if ctx.opts.UserID == user_model.ActionsUserID {
		taskID := ctx.opts.ActionsTaskID
		ctx.user = user_model.NewActionsUserWithTaskID(taskID)
		if taskID == 0 {
			log.Error("HookPreReceive: ActionsUser with task ID 0")
			ctx.JSON(http.StatusInternalServerError, private.Response{
				Err: "ActionsUser with task ID 0",
			})
			return false
		}

		userPerm, err := access_model.GetActionsUserRepoPermission(ctx, ctx.Repo.Repository, ctx.user, taskID)
		if err != nil {
			log.Error("Unable to get Actions user repo permission for task %d Error: %v", taskID, err)
			ctx.JSON(http.StatusInternalServerError, private.Response{
				Err: fmt.Sprintf("Unable to get Actions user repo permission for task %d Error: %v", taskID, err),
			})
			return false
		}
		ctx.userPerm = userPerm
	} else {
		user, err := user_model.GetUserByID(ctx, ctx.opts.UserID)
		if err != nil {
			log.Error("Unable to get User id %d Error: %v", ctx.opts.UserID, err)
			ctx.JSON(http.StatusInternalServerError, private.Response{
				Err: fmt.Sprintf("Unable to get User id %d Error: %v", ctx.opts.UserID, err),
			})
			return false
		}
		ctx.user = user
		userPerm, err := access_model.GetDoerRepoPermission(ctx, ctx.Repo.Repository, user)
		if err != nil {
			log.Error("Unable to get Repo permission of repo %s/%s of User %s: %v", ctx.Repo.Repository.OwnerName, ctx.Repo.Repository.Name, user.Name, err)
			ctx.JSON(http.StatusInternalServerError, private.Response{
				Err: fmt.Sprintf("Unable to get Repo permission of repo %s/%s of User %s: %v", ctx.Repo.Repository.OwnerName, ctx.Repo.Repository.Name, user.Name, err),
			})
			return false
		}
		ctx.userPerm = userPerm
	}

	if ctx.opts.DeployKeyID != 0 {
		deployKey, err := asymkey_model.GetDeployKeyByID(ctx, ctx.opts.DeployKeyID)
		if err != nil {
			log.Error("Unable to get DeployKey id %d Error: %v", ctx.opts.DeployKeyID, err)
			ctx.JSON(http.StatusInternalServerError, private.Response{
				Err: fmt.Sprintf("Unable to get DeployKey id %d Error: %v", ctx.opts.DeployKeyID, err),
			})
			return false
		}
		ctx.deployKeyAccessMode = deployKey.Mode
	}
	return true
```
```text
}

func NewRequestWithBody(t testing.TB, method, urlStr string, body io.Reader) *RequestWrapper {
	t.Helper()
	if !strings.HasPrefix(urlStr, "http:") && !strings.HasPrefix(urlStr, "https:") && !strings.HasPrefix(urlStr, "/") {
		t.Fatalf("invalid url str: %s", urlStr)
	}
	req, err := http.NewRequest(method, urlStr, body)
	assert.NoError(t, err)
	if req.URL.User != nil {
		req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Basic "+base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(req.URL.User.String())))
	}
	req.RequestURI = req.URL.Path
	if req.URL.RawQuery != "" {
		req.RequestURI += "?" + req.URL.RawQuery
	}
	return &RequestWrapper{req}
}

const NoExpectedStatus = 0

func MakeRequest(t testing.TB, rw *RequestWrapper, expectedStatus int) *httptest.ResponseRecorder {
	t.Helper()
	req := rw.Request
	recorder := httptest.NewRecorder()
	if req.RemoteAddr == "" {
		req.RemoteAddr = "test-mock:12345"
	}
	// Ensure unknown contentLength is seen as -1
	if req.Body != nil && req.ContentLength == 0 {
		req.ContentLength = -1
	}
	testWebRoutes.ServeHTTP(recorder, req)
	if expectedStatus != NoExpectedStatus {
		if expectedStatus != recorder.Code {
			logUnexpectedResponse(t, recorder)
			// don't use "require" which exits the test case and makes "wait group" wait forever
			assert.Equal(t, expectedStatus, recorder.Code, "Request: %s %s", req.Method, req.URL.String())
		}
	}
	return recorder
}
```

```text
532	// authenticate uses the authorization string to determine whether
533	// to proceed. This server assumes an HTTP Basic auth format.
534	func authenticate(ctx *context.Context, repository *repo_model.Repository, authorization string, requireSigned, requireWrite bool) bool {
535		accessMode := perm_model.AccessModeRead
536		if requireWrite {
537			accessMode = perm_model.AccessModeWrite
538		}
539
540		if taskID, ok := user_model.GetActionsUserTaskID(ctx.Doer); ok {
541			perm, err := access_model.GetActionsUserRepoPermission(ctx, repository, ctx.Doer, taskID)
542			if err != nil {
543				log.Error("Unable to GetActionsUserRepoPermission for task[%d] Error: %v", taskID, err)
544				return false
545			}
546			return perm.CanAccess(accessMode, unit.TypeCode)
547		}
548
549		// it works for both anonymous request and signed-in user, then perm.CanAccess will do the permission check
550		perm, err := access_model.GetDoerRepoPermission(ctx, repository, ctx.Doer)
551		if err != nil {
552			log.Error("Unable to GetDoerRepoPermission for user %-v in repo %-v Error: %v", ctx.Doer, repository, err)
553			return false
554		}
555
556		canAccess := perm.CanAccess(accessMode, unit.TypeCode)
557		// if it doesn't require sign-in and anonymous user has access, return true
558		// if the user is already signed in (for example: by session auth method), and the doer can access, return true
559		if canAccess && (!requireSigned || ctx.IsSigned) {
560			return true
561		}
562
563		// now, either sign-in is required or the ctx.Doer cannot access, check the LFS token
564		// however, "ctx.Doer exists but cannot access then check LFS token" should not really happen:
565		// * why a request can be sent with both valid user session and valid LFS token then use LFS token to access?
566		user, err := parseToken(ctx, authorization, repository, accessMode)
567		if err != nil {
568			// Most of these are Warn level - the true internal server errors are logged in parseToken already
569			log.Warn("Authentication failure for provided token with Error: %v", err)
570			return false
571		}
572		ctx.Doer = user
573		return true
574	}
575
576	func handleLFSToken(ctx stdCtx.Context, tokenSHA string, target *repo_model.Repository, mode perm_model.AccessMode) (*user_model.User, error) {
577		token, err := jwt.ParseWithClaims(tokenSHA, &Claims{}, func(t *jwt.Token) (any, error) {
578			if _, ok := t.Method.(*jwt.SigningMethodHMAC); !ok {
579				return nil, fmt.Errorf("unexpected signing method: %v", t.Header["alg"])
580			}
581			return setting.LFS.JWTSecretBytes, nil
582		})
583		if err != nil {
584			return nil, errors.New("invalid token")
585		}
586
587		claims, claimsOk := token.Claims.(*Claims)
588		if !token.Valid || !claimsOk {
589			return nil, errors.New("invalid token claim")
590		}
591
592		if claims.RepoID != target.ID {
593			return nil, errors.New("invalid token claim")
594		}
595
596		if mode == perm_model.AccessModeWrite && claims.Op != "upload" {
597			return nil, errors.New("invalid token claim")
598		}
599
600		u, err := user_model.GetUserByID(ctx, claims.UserID)
601		if err != nil {
602			log.Error("Unable to GetUserById[%d]: Error: %v", claims.UserID, err)
603			return nil, err
604		}
605		if !u.IsActive || u.ProhibitLogin {
606			return nil, util.NewPermissionDeniedErrorf("not allowed to access any repository")
607		}
608
609		perm, err := access_model.GetDoerRepoPermission(ctx, target, u)
610		if err != nil {
611			log.Error("Unable to GetDoerRepoPermission for user[%d] repo[%d]: %v", claims.UserID, target.ID, err)
612			return nil, err
613		}
614		if !perm.CanAccess(mode, unit.TypeCode) {
615			return nil, util.NewPermissionDeniedErrorf("no permission to access the repository")
616		}
617		return u, nil
618	}
619
620	func parseToken(ctx stdCtx.Context, authorization string, target *repo_model.Repository, mode perm_model.AccessMode) (*user_model.User, error) {
621		if authorization == "" {
622			return nil, errors.New("no token")
623		}
624		parsed, ok := httpauth.ParseAuthorizationHeader(authorization)
625		if !ok || parsed.BearerToken == nil {
626			return nil, errors.New("token not found")
627		}
628		return handleLFSToken(ctx, parsed.BearerToken.Token, target, mode)
629	}
630
631	func requireAuth(ctx *context.Context) {
632		ctx.Resp.Header().Set("WWW-Authenticate", `Basic realm="gitea-lfs"`)
633		writeStatus(ctx, http.StatusUnauthorized)
634	}
```

```text
36		return func(ctx *Context) {
37			errorFn := func(status int, msg string) {

43				}
44			}
45			paCtx := &packageAssignmentCtx{Base: ctx.Base, Doer: ctx.Doer, ContextUser: ctx.ContextUser}
46			ctx.Package = packageAssignment(paCtx, errorFn)
47		}

58	func packageAssignment(ctx *packageAssignmentCtx, errCb func(int, string)) *Package {

113	func determineAccessMode(ctx *Base, pkgOwner, doer *user_model.User) (perm.AccessMode, error) {
114		if setting.Service.RequireSignInViewStrict && (doer == nil || doer.IsGhost()) {
115			return perm.AccessModeNone, nil
116		}
117
118		if doer != nil && !doer.IsGhost() && (!doer.IsActive || doer.ProhibitLogin) {
119			return perm.AccessModeNone, nil
120		}
121
122		// TODO: ActionUser permission check
123		accessMode := perm.AccessModeNone
124		if pkgOwner.IsOrganization() {
125			org := organization.OrgFromUser(pkgOwner)
126
127			if doer != nil && !doer.IsGhost() {
128				// 1. If user is logged in, check all team packages permissions
129				var err error
130				accessMode, err = org.GetOrgUserMaxAuthorizeLevel(ctx, doer.ID)
131				if err != nil {
132					return accessMode, err
133				}
134				// If access mode is less than write check every team for more permissions
135				// The minimum possible access mode is read for org members
136				if accessMode < perm.AccessModeWrite {
137					teams, err := organization.GetUserOrgTeams(ctx, org.ID, doer.ID)
138					if err != nil {
139						return accessMode, err
140					}
141					for _, t := range teams {
142						perm := t.UnitAccessMode(ctx, unit.TypePackages)
143						if accessMode < perm {
144							accessMode = perm
145						}
146					}
147				}
148			}
149			if accessMode == perm.AccessModeNone && organization.HasOrgOrUserVisible(ctx, pkgOwner, doer) {
150				// 2. If user is unauthorized or no org member, check if org is visible
151				accessMode = perm.AccessModeRead
152			}
153		} else {
154			if doer != nil && !doer.IsGhost() {
155				// 1. Check if user is package owner
156				if doer.ID == pkgOwner.ID {
157					accessMode = perm.AccessModeOwner
158				} else if pkgOwner.Visibility == structs.VisibleTypePublic || pkgOwner.Visibility == structs.VisibleTypeLimited { // 2. Check if package owner is public or limited
159					accessMode = perm.AccessModeRead
160				}
161			} else if pkgOwner.Visibility == structs.VisibleTypePublic { // 3. Check if package owner is public
162				accessMode = perm.AccessModeRead
163			}
164		}
165
166		return accessMode, nil
167	}

172		return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
173			return http.HandlerFunc(func(resp http.ResponseWriter, req *http.Request) {
174				base := NewBaseContext(resp, req)
175				// FIXME: web Context is still needed when rendering 500 page in a package handler
176				// It should be refactored to use new error handling mechanisms
177				ctx := NewWebContext(base, renderer, nil)
178				next.ServeHTTP(ctx.Resp, ctx.Req)
179			})
180		}
181	}
```

```text
func PrepareTestEnv(t *testing.T, skip int, syncModels ...any) (db.EngineMigration, func()) {
	t.Helper()
	ourSkip := 2
	ourSkip += skip
	deferFn := testlogger.PrintCurrentTest(t, ourSkip)
	giteaRoot := setting.GetGiteaTestSourceRoot()
	require.NoError(t, unittest.SyncDirs(filepath.Join(giteaRoot, "tests/gitea-repositories-meta"), setting.RepoRootPath))

	cleanup, err := unittest.ResetTestDatabase()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unable to reset database: %v", err)
		return nil, deferFn
	}
	{
		oldDefer := deferFn
		deferFn = func() {
			cleanup()
			oldDefer()
		}
	}

	err = db.InitEngine(t.Context())
	if !assert.NoError(t, err) {
		return nil, deferFn
	}
	x := unittest.GetXORMEngine()
	{
		oldDefer := deferFn
		deferFn = func() {
			_ = x.Close()
			oldDefer()
		}
	}
```
